excerpt:
Shall the Board of Directors of the Spirit 
Lake Community School District in the 
County of Dickinson, State of Iowa, be 
authorized to contract indebtedness and 
issue General Obligation Bonds in an 
amount not to exceed $69,990,000 to 
provide funds to remodel, repair, improve, 
and equip existing school buildings, 
including academic, common, and 
extracurricular spaces at the high school, 
middle school, and elementary school; to 
build, furnish, and equip additions to the 
high school, middle school, and elementary 
school; to build a new bus barn; and to 
improve the sites, including improvements 
to existing athletic facilities and the 
elementary playground?
